Floor Preparation and Levelling

We assess the existing subfloor and carry out the preparation, repairs and levelling it needs before your new floor goes down, on every job across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.

Call 07748 146181 WhatsApp Us

Preparation Comes First

Floor preparation and levelling is on our list of services in its own right, and it's part of every floor we fit. We believe preparation is just as important as the flooring itself.

Before any engineered wood, LVT, herringbone or laminate goes down, we check that the subfloor is clean, level, dry and suitable for installation.

What We Check, Floor by Floor

  • Engineered wood: Where required, we carry out professional floor preparation, moisture testing and levelling before installation.
  • LVT: Smoothing, repairs and suitable floor levelling compounds, then manufacturer-approved primers and adhesives for proper bonding. A perfectly finished LVT floor starts with a well prepared subfloor.
  • Herringbone: Detailed subfloor inspections, moisture testing and professional preparation, before the pattern is set out from the centre line.
  • Laminate: We check levels and make sure the subfloor is clean, dry and suitable, then use suitable underlays and moisture protection.

Mid Installation

Herringbone part laid over the prepared subfloor, with the rest of the floor still to go down.

What Goes Wrong Without It

One of the biggest problems we see is inadequate subfloor preparation. Some installers rush the process without thoroughly checking moisture levels, floor levels or the condition of the existing surface.

On wood floors that leads to movement, gaps, creaking and premature flooring problems. On LVT, uneven surfaces and poor smoothing show through as visible imperfections, lifting edges and an inconsistent finish. Laminate laid over uneven or damp subfloors moves, lifts and gaps.

We never cut corners to save time. We'd rather take the time to inspect, measure and prepare every surface correctly.

Taking Up the Old Floor

We can also arrange the removal and disposal of your existing flooring as part of a complete installation package.

Your Questions
